committed: 2026-10-31, before the realtime/compiled models below were evaluated against their truth models
rationale: Truth model vs compiled model residuals for two declared-inference networks. They bound the linearisation and closed-form errors of the realtime path against an offline double-precision Newton solve of the same schematic equations; they are not analog tolerances and no hardware was measured.

ba_diode_boundary_v1.description: Selected BA column driver (2SC458 follower, +10.6 V rail) through a 1S1555 isolation diode and the matrix resistor into the assembled bus (one 10 k shunt) and the compiled receiver load. Compiled path: Thevenin equivalent linearised at the reference operating point (zero envelope and touch). Truth: Newton solve of the same nonlinear node at each drive.
ba_diode_boundary_v1.drive_range: every voice filter-EG state z in [-3, 3] (the sanitizeDrive bounds) and velocity/pressure in [0, 1]

memory_panel_v1.description: Memory/PANEL pot banks on the selected endpoint rail, memory diode or follower+diode paths and the assembled bus, for all four memories and PANEL in every selector state. Compiled path: closed-form loaded wiper Thevenin plus one linearised diode. Truth: Newton solve of the full multi-source node with every inactive source present.
